task_title: Pick futures prop firm for our bot
task_details:
Criteria (docs/research/prop-firm-math.md): 50k acct, NO consistency rule in eval, EOD drawdown (not intraday trailing), allows automated NinjaTrader trading, cheap fee, sane funded payout rules. Shortlist from memory: Lucid Flex, Tradeify, Topstep, Take Profit Trader, Apex, MFFU. Must verify CURRENT rules on each firm site - esp. bot/automation policy.
[2026-09-10T07:56:48.832620+00:00 -> discussing] Researched 2026-09-10 -> docs/research/prop-firm-shortlist.md. #1 Tradeify Growth 50K (, no eval consistency,  EOD, bots OK w/ video proof + no multi-firm bot use). #2 Lucid Flex (50% eval consistency barely matters at our sizing per sim; no funded consistency). Out: Topstep (TopstepX-only, no NinjaTrader), Apex (no automation). Waiting on user to pick; confirm Lucid bot policy on its own site (403 to our fetcher).
[2026-09-10T08:36:31.291522+00:00 -> discussing] Costs + Malaysia check 2026-09-10: Tradeify lists Malaysia as RESTRICTED (pickapropfirm data 2026-09-10, funded.now) -> Tradeify out. Lucid Flex allows Malaysia: one-time ~$65-149, no monthly/activation/data (certify CME Non-Pro), NT free, MNQ ~$1 RT. Payout for MY = WorkMarket bank wire only (crypto banned for MY since 2026-08-26), ~$10-25 + 1-2% FX. Leaning Lucid Flex; still confirm Lucid bot policy + LucidLive costs with Lucid support. Details in docs/research/prop-firm-shortlist.md.
[2026-09-10T09:07:54.862817+00:00 -> discussing] Lucid help center now readable via r.jina.ai proxy. Confirmed on Lucid's own site: bots + trade copiers allowed (Other Trading Activities), VPS fine + VPN allowed (support chat, user pasted), Malaysia not restricted. New: user wants to register as business (MY sole prop Quantum Capital Global = only active bank acct). Profile type is PERMANENT (1 profile ever, no personal<->business convert); business needs incorporation+ownership docs + ID to compliance@lucidtrading.com and separate WorkMarket business KYC. Next: ask Lucid compliance if SSM sole-prop docs are accepted BEFORE registering; ask LucidLive data fees.
[2026-09-10T09:15:00.844099+00:00 -> discussing] Lucid support reply (pasted by user): SSM docs NOT confirmed as accepted (they only list incorporation/ownership/ID, types unspecified). Personal profile -> sole prop bank account: NO. Options: (A) ask compliance to pre-review SSM docs in writing BEFORE registering business profile (permanent choice); (B) open a personal bank account and register personal (recommended, lower risk). Waiting on user.
[2026-09-10T09:24:50.090548+00:00 -> discussing] Firm decided: Lucid (Tradeify out, Malaysia restricted). Still open under this task: (1) which Lucid account type to buy - LucidFlex vs LucidPro vs LucidDirect, size 25K/50K/100K/150K, DLL on/off, how many accounts (max 5 funded/household); user wants to discuss this next session. (2) Register personal (open personal bank acct, recommended) vs business (needs Lucid compliance to pre-approve SSM docs in writing).
[2026-09-10T09:30:41.790779+00:00 -> discussing] Lucid plan comparison 2026-09-10 (docs/research/prop-firm-shortlist.md): Flex pays only 50% of cycle profit; Pro/Daily pay ~all profit above one-time 2,100 buffer -> better for our ~90/day bot past ~4.2k lifetime profit. Daily = funded intraday DD + red-folder news hard breach. Direct = 364 to skip eval, not worth it. Recommended: LucidPro 50K DLL ON (DLL 1,200 > our worst day -900; also stops runaway bot), 1 acct first then scale to 5 via copier. Runner-up LucidDaily. Don't buy until bot is backtested (30 days no P/L = account deleted). Waiting on user to confirm plan type.
[2026-09-10T09:38:34.873085+00:00 -> discussing] User asked me to decide (2026-09-10): LucidPro 50K DLL ON. User pasted a Lucid summary claiming Pro has 'no simulated payout caps' and Flex pays 500-1,000 per request - conflicts with help center (Pro 50K cap 2k then 2.5k; Flex 50K cap 2k per support). Ask support to confirm Pro 50K per-request cap + 40% funded consistency before buying. Doesn't change the pick. Next: personal vs business signup.
